requiredBehaviors.behavior: reject PR-closed and tracker-done as sufficient engineering closure
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The hardened quality principles explicitly reject PR-Closed, Merge or Tracker-Done alone as full Engineering Closure.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: surface stale review, missing merge evidence and missing requirement verification
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Project-state reconstruction separates reviewedHeadSha, current head, merge state, tracker state and requirement verification and leaves missing states explicit.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: make the earliest delivery or verification gap the next action instead of starting a new feature
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The next-increment ordering places open delivery/closure gaps before the next independent feature when prior integration remains unverified.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat a closed PR as proof of merge
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: PR state and merge evidence are separate.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat tracker done as proof that requirements are verified
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Tracker closure does not replace acceptance and requirement verification.
